ctx.x: Now, Benny Carter, you see, Benny Carter, when he plays, it sounds like nothing but if you listen to what that man is doing and -- (inaudible) -- piano, and so he come from there. That's what happens, see. That's what happens to you, so that's what he does.

These -- what do you call -- (sentence in foreign language) -- that means, that man, he knows everything. But he's humble with it. He doesn't exploit it. He's not arrogant. He's got mother-wit, he's an artist and everything, but he doesn't exploit it.
